title: thelypteris thelypterioides
intro: Thelypteris thelypterioides, commonly known as the Pteris fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta, characterized by its fronds with a central rachis and pinnae. The health benefits of Thelypteris thelypterioides include its potential use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
